keys: Command log and analysis code for low-cost robot teleoperation over consumer 4G
Bounding the command emission rate in low-cost robot teleoperation over consumer 4G
Muhammad Haffez Mohd Zaki and Noor Azizi Mardi

evidence: Read original server CSV, publisher analysis, README, licence and results ZIP. The accompanying article is described by the depositors as under review. No paper result is asserted.
version_note: The V1.0 and V1.1 records have identical original CSV bytes by their published MD5; their analysis scripts differ. Count one log.
instrumentation: Browser Date.now() measures the interval from command request to its response. The recorded server timestamp is the arrival of a subsequent browser log request. Its server wall-clock zone is unspecified. Angles are commands, and the all-six code records only J1/J2 angles. No arm encoders, packet capture, per-command motor-start events, actual drive current or mechanical completion times are in this log.
coverage: 4,485 records over 12 server calendar dates; 242 have zero RTT, including 33 from two all-zero voice submodes. All strictly positive RTT records are included (4,243). Modes with no positive measurements have empty quantiles.
method: For each positive RTT d and server time S (millisecond of day), define finish proxy C=S and emission proxy E=S-d. Within a server date count pairs with E_j-E_i>B and C_i-C_j>B, j thus reconstructed to send later but receive a reply earlier. Unknown residual time u of the follow-up log request offsets both E and C for that command by minus u. The count at B is guaranteed to stay reversed only under the hypothetical condition 0<=u<=B ms for every command. All B are sensitivity parameters, not measured bounds.
findings: 12,039 reversed pairs across dates at B=0 ms. At 25 ms there are 11,993; at 100 ms there are 11,676 involving 1,147 distinct later-emitted rows; 11,420 of those pairs occur on 2026-06-05. The browser and application timing does not identify any individual radio-packet reordering, per-direction queue or physical robot lag.
reproduce: python derive_mycobot.py data_pergerakan_robot.csv OUT (Python 3 plus NumPy).
